newsitem.title: UK: UK MO rises to s/a 24.933 bln stg week to Feb 26.
newsitem.headline: UK MO rises to s/a 24.933 bln stg week to Feb 26.

text.p: British M0 money supply rose to a provisional seasonally adjusted 24.933 billion sterling in the week to February 26 from 24.913 billion the previous week, the Bank of England said on Monday. On an unadjusted basis M0 rose to 24.285 billion sterling from 24.179 billion the week before.
Notes and coins in circulation dropped to 24.818 billion sterling from 24.880 billion on a seasonally adjusted basis but rose to an unadjusted 24.170 billion from 24.146 the previous week.
